description: Kryptic machine auth derivation known-answer test for v2 client secrets (prefix "ksm2_"). authSecret = base64url(HKDF-SHA256(ikm = UTF-8 secret, salt = UTF-8 "kryptic.machine.auth.v2", info = UTF-8 "auth", length 32)). The raw secret never goes on the wire: machines present authSecret at token exchange and keep the raw secret for local wrap-key derivation. Legacy secrets without the prefix are presented unchanged. Every runtime exchanging machine tokens must reproduce this output.
